title: I still need your help in proving my platform worth!
author: azagor
selftext:
I am a solo developer behind Perun The Trader. I keep improving my solution spending most of my free time on it. Its a tough market. I need a little more help from community. Not so long ago my platform was evaluated by KuCoin and and I join them as broker with 0auth enabled for my users. On my website there are still promo codes for KuCoin user available. With the code you can get the app for free from google play. I don't need much. Just give it a shot. Send me feedback. I will always replay. Currently there is a contest on KuCoin and Perun The Trader is one of participants. I would really appreciate it if you would join my team on the contest. This is something that could be a game changer for my platform. It works really well. Much better than great majority of the big players. I just need more publicity. In order to have the team accepted I need at least 5 members. Here are some details from KuCoin:

🔥 KuCoin Broker League: Global Trading Clash

Brokers and their communities, it’s time to compete! 🏆

A total of 50,000 USDT is up for grabs, with 20,000 USDT for the 1st-place team.

📅 Event Period: Sep 16, 16:00 – Oct 16, 15:59 (UTC)

How to qualify?

👥 Build a team with at least 5 eligible members

📈 Reach 3,000,000 USDT in team trading volume

🎯 Each eligible member needs at least 1,000 USDT in personal trading volume

🏆 The Top 20 qualifying teams will share the prize pool

Your team's total trading volume determines your rank — so rally your community and push for the top! 🚀

[https://link.kucoin.com/iqEP/4g6oboys?activityId=KA\_teamcup\_brokerleague&inviteTeam=10040986&campaignId=ka\_teamcup\_brokerleague0917&campaignType=1&rcode=CXE8QUXY&utm\_source=competition&appNeedLang=true](https://link.kucoin.com/iqEP/4g6oboys?activityId=KA_teamcup_brokerleague&inviteTeam=10040986&campaignId=ka_teamcup_brokerleague0917&campaignType=1&rcode=CXE8QUXY&utm_source=competition&appNeedLang=true)

You can find more info about Perun the Trader on my website: peruninthemachine.com. There is contact info. Feel free to ping me at any time.

Thank you!!!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Getting through a broker integration as a solo dev is a real milestone and you are underselling it by putting it three lines down.

The ask at the end is doing you no favours though. Help me prove it is worth something puts the work on the reader, and most people will not take that on for a stranger. Lead with one specific thing it does that someone can check in a minute.

replies.author: azagor
replies.body: Help me prove it worth is getting wider audience which is not easy with general advetisment ban for crypto. The platform provoes itself but it has no meaning if there are no voices to share it. That's what I meant.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Free with promo codes isn't the problem and neither is the ad ban. Nobody knows what they'd be testing. Pick the single hardest thing your backtest does that a spreadsheet can't, post that one result with the numbers on it, and let the platform be the footnote.
